title: hyperannotatR: Region-of-Interest Annotation for Hyperspectral Data
description: hyperannotatR provides tools for annotating regions of interest in hyperspectral data cubes and their associated display rasters. Annotations are held as validated simple-feature geometries in image pixel coordinates with explicit pyramid-level transforms, so that a region drawn at one zoom level remains correct at every other. Regions can be rasterised into binary, labelled or multi-class integer masks for use in downstream segmentation and classification work. A batch annotation application supports resumable sessions across queues of images, live mask preview, and export to GeoJSON, QuPath and TIFF. It is aimed at researchers preparing ground-truth labels for hyperspectral image analysis.
